description: Ford's modern high-performance DOHC V8, designed as the spiritual successor to the legendary 5.0L Windsor. Features dual overhead cams, 4 valves per cylinder, and variable cam timing. Revived the '5.0' badge and became instantly popular with enthusiasts for its high-revving nature and impressive naturally aspirated power.

heritage.significance: Revival of the 5.0 badge with modern technology, created new performance benchmark
innovations: Composite intake manifold with charge motion control valves
Plasma transferred wire arc (PTWA) cylinder coating
High-flow cylinder heads with 4 valves per cylinder

racing_heritage.nascar: FR9 race engine derived from Coyote architecture
racing_heritage.road_racing: Powers Ford Performance Mustang racing programs
racing_heritage.drag_racing: Very popular in sportsman and NMRA racing

base_specifications.valvetrain: DOHC, 4 valves per cylinder, roller finger followers
base_specifications.fuel_system: Sequential Multi-Port EFI (Gen 1/2), Direct Injection + Port Injection (Gen 3)

variants.notes: Revised heads and intake for improved power
Direct injection + port injection, higher compression, 7500 RPM redline
Mach 1 version with GT350 intake manifold and improved oil cooling
Ford Performance crate engine with forged internals for NA use
Ford Performance crate engine with forged internals for forced induction
Ford Performance 5.2L crate engine based on Coyote/Voodoo architecture

common_issues.solution: PCV update, oil separator catch can

common_issues.description: Cam phaser or lash adjuster noise
common_issues.solution: Usually normal, check oil level and quality
Replace timing components as a set

strengths: Excellent naturally aspirated power (460+ HP stock)
Crate engine program makes swaps easy

notes.gen1_vs_gen2_vs_gen3: Gen 2 improved heads and intake over Gen 1. Gen 3 added direct injection for higher compression and better fuel economy while increasing power.
notes.swappability: Very popular swap engine. Ford Performance offers complete crate engine and control pack for simplified installation.
notes.forced_induction: With Aluminator XS crate engine or built internals, Coyotes regularly make 700-1000+ HP with superchargers.
